description.content: Stories are the content entries in Storyblok. Each story is defined by a component schema and holds the content of a page, post, or any other structured content type.

Returns a paginated list of published stories from the space. Stories can be filtered by slug, tag, component type, and custom fields. The response includes the story content along with metadata such as publication dates and alternate language versions. Pagination is controlled via the page and per_page query parameters.

query.description: (Required) The API access token for the space. Use the public token to access published content or the preview token to access draft content.
Content version to retrieve. Use published to get published content (default) or draft to get the latest saved draft. The draft version requires the preview API token.
Page number for paginated results. Starts at 1. Requesting a page higher than the last available page returns an empty array.
Number of items to return per page. Maximum is 100 for most endpoints.
Filter stories by full_slug prefix. Only stories whose full_slug starts with the given value are returned. Useful for fetching content within a specific folder.
Comma-separated list of full_slug values to retrieve specific stories by their slugs.
Comma-separated list of full_slug values to exclude from the results.
Comma-separated list of tag slugs to filter stories by. Multiple tags are treated as an OR condition.
Set to 1 to only return folder start pages. Set to 0 to exclude them. Omit to return all stories.
Sort the response by a specific field and direction. Supports all default story fields and custom fields defined in the component schema. Format: field:asc or field:desc.
Full-text search term to filter stories whose content fields contain the given string.
Comma-separated list of component.field paths to resolve referenced story relations inline in the response.
Set to story to resolve story link fields. Set to url to resolve to the story URL string.
ISO language code to return the story content in the specified language. Falls back to the default language if the translation is unavailable.
Fallback language code used when the requested language translation is not available.
Object to filter stories by custom field values using operators such as in, not_in, like, gt-int, lt-int. Keys are field paths relative to the story content object.
Comma-separated list of story UUIDs to retrieve specific stories by their unique identifiers.
Comma-separated list of story IDs to exclude from the results.
Number of stories to return per page. Maximum 100.
Cache version timestamp. Pass the current Unix timestamp to bypass CDN caching and retrieve the latest content.

response.name: A paginated list of stories was returned successfully.

header.description: Total number of stories matching the query.

info.name: Storyblok Content Delivery API v2 Assets Stories API

description.content:
The Storyblok Content Delivery API v2 is a REST API that enables developers to fetch published content from a Storyblok space for delivery to end users across web, mobile, and other channels. It provides access to stories, datasources, links, tags, and asset metadata through predictable endpoints with token-based authentication. The API supports filtering, pagination, full-text search, and relation resolution, allowing developers to retrieve precisely the content their application needs. It is optimized for performance and available across multiple regional endpoints to minimize latency for global deployments.
